mechanism: Both agents can cause skin irritation and potential additive dermatologic effects; brimonidine may cause facial flushing and erythema while tazarotene causes retinoid dermatitis, potentially compromising skin barrier function in periocular areas.
action: Monitor for excessive skin irritation, erythema, or dermatitis in periocular region; consider spacing applications and use appropriate emollients; counsel patient on potential cumulative irritant effects.
